name: proof-of-impact
description: Proof of Impact — a blockchain-based public resource accountability platform

scripts.db:setup: npm run db:migrate && npm run db:seed
scripts.build: npm run build -w @poi/api && npm run build -w @poi/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @poi/shared && npm run typecheck -w @poi/api && npm run typecheck -w @poi/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @poi/shared && npm run test -w @poi/contracts && npm run test -w @poi/api && npm run test -w @poi/web
